scope: Frozen agent/content.ts and transcript.ts, with only their canonical shared carrier facts. No agent factory, provider, SDK, children, schema guards, status function or lifecycle projector port.

design.parts: ContentPart exhaustively holds Rc<TextPart/ImagePart/FilePart>; Parts is Rc<RefCell<Vec<ContentPart>>>. content_parts returns the original array or fresh one-text-part array; omit_media retains text and mints media placeholders. JsText remains the canonical UTF16 owner.
design.media: MediaBytes is an Rc view over fixed Rc<[Cell<u8>]> storage. Checked native range views share backing storage and mutations; copied allocates independent storage. Conditional serialization uses actual string index keys as Source Uint8Array JSON does. Native helpers do not reimplement JavaScript typed-array index coercion.
design.collector: Transcript<R,T=AgentTurn,F=PlainData> keeps Rc turn/result/status identities and fresh snapshot arrays. Typed dense seed copies the outer arrays and filters only OK tool results in settle order; duplicates and late events remain. Running is distinct from Ended(existing Rc<AgentEndedStatus>), and Done(None) is valid. Ended serializes flat, with no accidental wrapper. listener owns the same local collector, and snapshots do not require Clone/serde/Send/static on underlying data.
design.canonicalFacts: One types.rs owns ToolCall/AgentTurn/Usage/Conversation/Awaiting/ToolRecord/ToolOutcome and AgentEvent/Head/EndedStatus carriers. The terminal failure remains typed opaque F until the factory binds it; no placeholder AgentFailure union was introduced. Existing QueueField optional-property and PlainData/JsonData owners are reused. Only wire serialization adds Serialize bounds.
design.rawBoundary: from_plain_seed specialises the existing canonical PlainData boundary. It preserves measured nullish defaults, Source property access errors, exact two array-operation refusals, and UTF16 code-point string iteration. It intentionally requires a string callId, so malformed raw IDs are reported as known boundary differences, never Source-exact.

redGreen.nestedMedia: First actual shared trace was61/73strict: nested MediaBytes numeric native map keys failed canonical plain_data; fixed to actual string index properties. The original red report is retained and a public nested-media wire regression was added.
redGreen.rawErrorEvidence: The first observer attempted standalone JSON of Undefined offending values; the boundary now retains valueKind=undefined while omitting the unrepresentable JSON field. Original native error data remains boxed in TranscriptSeedError.
redGreen.controlScope: Every mutant compiles as a disposable copy and mismatches its declared Source/native case. No compile failure or unrelated-only error counted as a detection.

blindSpots: Four malformed raw callId forms are retained by Source but refused by the native string-ID raw boundary; these are known differences, not strict parity.
Sparse/inherited/custom-iterator JS array behavior is measured manually and outside dense native sequence interfaces.
No agent factory/provider/SDK/children/schema/status/projector completion claim; those modules were inspected only as needed for canonical facts.
Pure constructors/updates need no serde/Clone/Send/static; caller-owned codecs are still needed at actual IO boundaries for opaque Rust data.
